lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 vertical columns of high-intensity circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains between 3 to 6 spots, forming a semi-orthogonal grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular spots. These bands are most prominent in the anterior section of the flank, creating a grid where spots act as vertex nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge runs mid-laterally from the gills to the caudal peduncle, characterized by a distinct pixel highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow on the ventral edge, creating a sharp vertical gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 10-15 smaller, less defined high-luminance blobs is scattered across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the lower two-thirds of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (Echeneidae) are visible: three positioned ventrally near the mid-body and at least one near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin. The pectoral fin displays a much denser, more chaotic arrangement of smaller spots compared to the primary lateral flank.
